validity.researcher_notes: This row has no SegmentName and blank/placeholder LengthKnownKm and Owner ('--') -- it is a system-level stub for the entire Columbia Gulf Transmission Pipeline (a multi-decade, multi-segment interstate system running through Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee and Kentucky), structurally similar to P0152's 'Main Line' row: no single physical construction event can honestly be represented by one StartYear1. Searched TC Energy's own Columbia Gulf operations/about pages, Wikipedia, and FundingUniverse's Columbia Gas System corporate history for a founding/in-service year and found no citable, specific commissioning year for the system as a whole. Also checked a company called 'Gulf Companies' (gulfcompanies.com/who-we-are/our-history/), which surfaced in search results claiming a 1953/1954 founding in connection with 'Gulf Interstate Gas Pipeline' construction; fetched the page directly and confirmed this is an entirely unrelated midstream services company, NOT GEM's Columbia Gulf Transmission, and excluded it to avoid a false attribution. A later search surfaced a claim, said to be sourced to PHMSA pipeline-incident records reproduced via ProPublica's now-discontinued Pipeline Safety Tracker (projects.propublica.org/pipelines/incidents/...), that Columbia Gulf pipe segments in Louisiana and Kentucky were installed in 1953 and 1954. Attempted to verify directly: the ProPublica Pipeline Safety Tracker site is explicitly marked 'no longer maintained... a partial snapshot made in 2025 of the original project', and the specific incident-record pages fetched (271282, 270644) returned only the project's generic landing/navigation shell -- no retrievable operator name, location, or installation-year data; the underlying incident database itself is gone and the specific 1953/1954 claim could not be confirmed to a citable standard. Given (a) no single system-wide start year can honestly be assigned to a multi-segment interstate trunk built across several decades, and (b) the one specific-year lead found could not be independently verified after a direct fetch attempt, StartYear1 is left UNRESOLVED rather than filled from an unverified claim.
